case_title: Ali Ahmad v. The State of Bihar & Anr.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302 IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused was convicted of murder under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code. The trial court sentenced the accused to life imprisonment. The case was appealed, and the High Court released the accused on bail. The Supreme Court found that the High Court did not follow the correct procedure under Section 389 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, which requires the public prosecutor to be given an opportunity to object to the release of a convicted person. The Supreme Court remanded the case to the High Court for reconsideration of the bail application in accordance with the legal procedure.
